description: Evidence manifest for proving DB metadata and artifact/report files were restored from the same backup point.
same_point_in_time_rule: db_backup.backup_point_id and artifact_backup.backup_point_id must match restore_point_id.
path_rules: absolute paths, UNC paths, drive-qualified paths, and parent traversal are invalid
hash_rules: sha256 values must be 64-character lowercase hex digests
notes: The validator checks evidence metadata only. It does not create backups, restore databases, copy files, delete files, or read file bytes.
